morphology.pattern_note: 按输入保留未加词缀形式；尚未证实其为马来语普通词根。以下仅提供可核实的专名 Ramon 用法，不代表已确认输入词的预期含义。

senses.zh_definition: 拉蒙：人名 Ramon 的音译，见于 Ramon Magsaysay（拉蒙·麦格赛赛）等专名。输入的小写形式 ramon 尚无已核实的马来语普通词义。
senses.en_definition: Ramon, a personal name occurring in names such as Ramon Magsaysay; a Malay common-word meaning for the supplied lowercase form remains unverified.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang, seperti Ramon dalam nama Ramon Magsaysay. Makna bentuk huruf kecil ramon sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum dapat disahkan; huraian ini bukan petikan definisi rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 此处 noun 指专有名词。人名应写作 Ramon，保留大写首字母。DBP 的百科资料可证实相关专名，但不能据此认定小写 ramon 是正式马来语词目。以下为专名组合和自拟例句，不是已证实的普通词搭配。参见 [DBP PRPM：Anugerah Ramon Magsaysay](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=penganugerahan)。词频排名仅沿用输入值。

etymology.historical_story: The supplied lowercase form has no verified Malay etymology in the evidence reviewed. A documented cultural connection is the personal name Ramon in the Ramon Magsaysay Award. Malaysian journalist Abdul Samad Ismail received this award in 1994 for his contribution to journalism and nation-building. This establishes a proper-name context, rather than a history for an ordinary Malay word. [Source: Ramon Magsaysay Award Foundation](https://rmaward.asia/rmawardees/samad-ismail-abdul/)

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 提及实际人物时采用其姓名及适当称谓；直接称呼对方时，应尊重其姓名读音和称呼偏好。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: Ramon 可用于人物姓名及包含该姓名的奖项名称。现有证据不足以把小写 ramon 作为普通马来语词教学，亦不足以补写官方爪夷文、音标或派生词族。
